pages.name: Tarrasch Defense: Classical Variation
pages.notes: Plan 3 proposed a b2-b4 break with no point; plan 4 pushed d5-d4 into White's d4-pawn. Rewrote around Bg5 or dxc5 and a conditional d-pawn advance; British spelling.

pages.name: Tarrasch Defense: Classical Variation, Chandler Variation
pages.notes: Plan 2 pushed d5-d4 into the d4-knight; made conditional; British spelling.

pages.name: Tarrasch Defense: Classical Variation, Endgame Variation
pages.notes: Plan 2 pushed ...d5-d4 into White's d4-pawn; made conditional on the central exchanges; British spelling.

pages.name: Tarrasch Defense: Classical Variation, Main Line
pages.notes: Plan 1 pushed ...d4 into the d4-knight; made conditional; British spelling. Plan 2 still says White controls d5 where d4 is meant (unchanged, reviewer noted).

pages.name: Tarrasch Defense: Classical Variation, Petursson Variation
pages.notes: Plan 1 proposed a minority attack in an IQP structure; plan 2 pushed ...d5-d4 into the knight; plan 3 moved the blockading knight off d4; plan 4 had the e8-rook hitting e2 through its own bishop. Rewrote all four; British spelling.

pages.name: QGD: Exchange, 4...Nxd5
pages.notes: Plan 3 had Bd3 and O-O with the e2-pawn blocking; plan 4 said controlling e5 restrains e4. Rewrote plans 1, 3 and 4 around e2-e4 hitting the d5-knight; British spelling.

pages.name: QGD: Exchange, 5.Bg5 Be7
pages.notes: Plan 1 wrote b4-b5 with the pawn still on b2; now b2-b4-b5; British spelling.

pages.name: QGD: Exchange, 5.Bg5 Be7 6.e3 Nbd7
pages.notes: Plan 2 had ...e5 with no black e-pawn; plan 4 ...f5-f4 kingside attack; plan 1 b4-b5 from b2; plan 3 0-0. Fixed; British spelling.

pages.name: QGD: Exchange, 5.Bg5 Be7 6.e3 O-O
pages.notes: Plan 3 had White preventing ...e5 with no black e-pawn; plan 4 called the c8-bishop bad and vague. Rewrote both; British spelling.

pages.name: QGD: Exchange, 5.Bg5 c6 6.e3
pages.notes: Plan 4 routed the bishop d7-e8-g6 through the king on e8; replaced with the standard ...Bf5 trade. Plan 1 b2-b4-b5; British spelling.
